title: Problem Overview
content: Erdős Problem #147: Turán Numbers for Bipartite Graphs. Status: DISPROVED (Janzer)

title: Turannumber
content: The Turán number ex(n; H): the maximum number of edges in a simple graph on n vertices that does not contain H as a subgraph.

title: Mindegree
content: The minimum degree of a simple graph on Fin k. Finset.inf' Finset.univ ⟨0, Finset.mem_univ 0⟩ (fun v => (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => G.Adj v w)).card)

title: Janzer Disproof
content: **Janzer's Disproof**: There exist bipartite graphs with minimum degree r ≥ 4 for which the Erdős-Simonovits conjecture fails.  For even r ≥ 4, Janzer constructed r-regular bipartite graphs H such that ex(n; H) ≤ C · n^{2 - 1/(r-1)} · (log n)^{O(1)}. ∀ r : ℕ, r ≥ 4 → Even r → ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ H : SimpleGr

title: Probabilistic Lower Bound
content: **Probabilistic lower bound** (weaker than conjectured): For bipartite H with minimum degree r, ex(n; H) ≫ n^{2 - 2/r + ε} for some ε > 0. ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ H : SimpleGraph (Fin k), H.IsBipartite ∧ ∃ c ε : ℝ, c > 0 ∧ ε > 0 ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ 2 → (turanNumber H n : ℝ) ≥ c * (n : ℝ) ^ (2 - 2 / (r : ℝ) + ε)

title: Erdos 147
content: The Erdős-Simonovits conjecture is false. Janzer constructed explicit counterexamples for all even r ≥ 4. ∃ r : ℕ, r ≥ 4 ∧ ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ H : SimpleGraph (Fin k), H.IsBipartite ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, C > 0 ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ 2 → (turanNumber H n : ℝ) ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (2 - 1 / ((r : ℝ) - 1)) * (Real.log n) ^ r := by use
